slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: Ghana appears only in the annex of composite score bands from the October 2016 monitoring survey: digitization of the civil registration system below 35 per cent (one of 21 countries in the lowest band), planning and coordination 65-79 per cent, overall 50-64 per cent; the report gives no per-country answer on electronic recording at local offices, so no aspect value can be taken.
